transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because ever since I tried to turn my art into a real freelance business, things have just been really overwhelming. I keep getting so wound up over invoices and client messages that I just... I end up avoiding them completely. 

Then I put it off until I'm literally crying at my kitchen table. It's gotten to the point where it's messing up my day-to-day life, and I'm forgetting normal stuff, like paying my own bills. I just need some help getting a handle on it.
Do you find that your anxiety about work or client interactions is interfering with your ability to perform your job or manage daily tasks?

Yeah, it definitely is. It's affecting both my freelance work and just... my normal home responsibilities. Like, recently I kept putting off replying to a client, and I was so focused on trying to keep up with this art display that I actually missed a utility payment. So, yeah, it's really getting in the way of getting things done.
Have you noticed yourself having repeated, unwanted thoughts that are hard to get rid of, or do you find yourself doing certain things over and over again because you feel you have to?

No, not really. I don't have anything like that. I mean, I definitely stress out about the freelance stuff and the emails, but it's not like weird thoughts get stuck in my head or anything. And I don't find myself doing things over and over again. If anything, I just avoid doing the things I'm actually supposed to do.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about things other than your freelance work or daily responsibilities, like everyday events or situations?

No, it's really just the freelance stuff. I mean, I don't really worry about everyday things or other situations. It's just... when it comes to the business side of my art, that's when I get all worked up. Everything else is pretty much fine.
When you get anxious about your freelance work or client interactions, do you notice any physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or shaking?

No, I don't really get anything like that. My heart doesn't race, and I don't get sweaty or shaky or anything. It's more just... a feeling of dread in my head, I guess. But physically, no, I feel pretty normal.
Do you feel anxious or nervous when you have to present your art or interact with clients in a professional setting, such as showing your work or discussing your projects?

Not really. I mean, talking about my art or showing it to people doesn't bother me at all. I actually kind of like that part. It's really just the... the emails, the deadlines, and trying to figure out the business details that make me avoid things. But just presenting my work or having a conversation with a client? No, I don't get nervous about that.

Have you ever felt anxious or avoided situations where you had to perform, present, or be observed by others, even outside of your freelance work, like speaking in front of a group or giving a presentation?

No, not really. I don't have a problem with that kind of thing. I mean, speaking in front of a group or having people watch me do something... it doesn't make me anxious or make me want to avoid it. It's really just the business side of my freelance stuff that gets to me.
Outside of your freelance work, do you ever feel anxious or uncomfortable in social situations where you might be judged or evaluated by others?

No, not at all. Social situations are fine for me. I don't worry about people judging me or anything like that. I actually enjoy being around people. It's really just the administrative side of my work that stresses me out, not socializing.
Have you experienced any significant anxiety or avoidance in other major areas of your life, such as relationships, health, or future uncertainties, outside of your freelance work stress?

No, not really. My relationships are good, and I don't really stress about my health or... or the future, really. It honestly is just that one specific area with the freelance admin stuff. Everything else in my life feels pretty normal and steady right now.

Have you ever felt anxious or overwhelmed when faced with tasks that require you to perform, even in non-social or non-client-related situations, like meeting deadlines for school, organizing events, or managing personal projects?

No, I don't think so. I mean, personal projects or meeting deadlines for other things... that doesn't bother me. It's really just the business side of my freelance work that makes me feel overwhelmed. Managing everything else is fine.
Do you feel anxious specifically when you have to complete tasks related to your freelance business, like invoicing or responding to emails, even if there’s no immediate pressure or deadline?

Yeah, that's exactly what happens. That's actually why I came in to see you. Ever since I tried to turn my art into a real freelance business, I just... I keep getting so wound up over invoices and client messages, even if there's no immediate rush. I just avoid them. And then I put it off until I'm crying at my kitchen table, or I get so overwhelmed that I start forgetting normal stuff, like paying my own bills at home.

Has this anxiety and avoidance around freelance tasks caused you significant distress or made it hard for you to function in important areas of your life, like your work performance, home responsibilities, or relationships?

Yes, it really has. It's definitely affecting my freelance work and even my responsibilities at home. Like I mentioned, I'll put off replying to a client for days, and then... well, recently I was so caught up trying to get an art display ready while avoiding the business side of things that I completely missed paying one of my utility bills. So, yeah, it's making it hard to just function normally right now.

Do you feel that your anxiety is mainly about how you perform or come across in your freelance work, such as worrying about mistakes or how others might see your work, or does it feel more like general stress about managing everything?

I don't think it's really about how I come across or worrying about mistakes with my work. I'm actually pretty confident in my art, so I don't worry too much about how people see that. And... I don't know if I'd call it general stress about managing everything, either. Like I said, I was always fine managing my personal life before I started doing this. 

It's really just... the business tasks themselves. The invoicing, the professional emails. I'm not entirely sure why that specific part overwhelms me so much, but I don't think it's about my performance. It's just those specific tasks that I can't seem to handle.

When you feel overwhelmed by tasks like invoicing or emails, is it because you're worried about how someone might judge your work or professionalism, or is it more about the tasks themselves feeling unpleasant or hard to start?

I don't think it's about being judged, really. I mean, I don't sit there worrying that a client is going to think I'm unprofessional or a bad artist or anything like that. It's more... it's just the tasks themselves. 

They just feel like this huge, impossible mountain to climb. The minute I think about opening an invoice template or drafting an email, I just feel this block, and it feels so unpleasant that I just can't bring myself to start. So, yeah, it's definitely more about the tasks just feeling too hard to initiate rather than worrying about what someone thinks of me.

When you avoid tasks like invoicing or responding to emails, does it feel like you're actively trying to avoid the anxiety those tasks bring, or does it feel more like you're just procrastinating or putting things off?

I think... it's a bit of both, maybe? I mean, I definitely put things off, but it's because thinking about doing them makes my chest feel tight. So I guess I am avoiding the anxiety by procrastinating. I just don't want to feel that stress, so I do something else instead.
